data.long_meaning: The name Kritartha is recorded with the meaning “Achieved, accomplished”. Kritartha is a Hindu name meaning “Achieved, accomplished”. in_sanskrit.name: कृतार्थ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who has accomplished his goals and desires, or has reached the end of a journey or task.

in_hindi.name: कृतार्थ
in_hindi.meaning: कृत: करना (to do) + अर्थ: पुरुषार्थ (goal, purpose)
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who has accomplished his goals or fulfilled his desires.

in_tamil.name: கிற்றார்த்த
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who has done a lot and is a great person.

in_telugu.name: కృదార్థ
in_telugu.meaning: కృద: कొట్టే (to do) + ఆర్థ: అర్ధము (goal, purpose)
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who has accomplished his goals or fulfilled his desires.

in_marathi.name: Kritartha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kritartha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who has accomplished or achieved his goals or desires

in_bengali.name: Kritartha
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Achieved, accomplished
in_bengali.long_meaning: Kritartha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who has accomplished or achieved his goals or desires
